lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 10th line (counting anterior to posterior) near the upper third of the torso mass, where the line splits into two downward-extending segments. A secondary Y-shaped split is visible at the dorsal origin of the 8th line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 2, 11, and 12 appear as abbreviated segments; Line 11 is represented as a dashed vertical series that fails to reach the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6-8 distinct white spots is located on the lower haunch, situated between the posterior-most vertical line and the tail base.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots align horizontally on the mid-haunch, creating a semi-connected geometric line approximately parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white patch on the ventral neck/throat transition; two distinct white spots located on the lower cheek/mandible region below the eye; transverse white bands visible on the carpus and tarsus regions of the limbs.
